info.title: Zellavora Nexus API
info.description:
Zellavora Nexus is a multi-tenant work-management platform API. This page is generated from the same route
definitions that run the server, so it cannot drift from the real behavior. Base path: `/api/v1`.

# Getting started

## 1. Sign in and get a token
1. `POST /auth/login` (`loginWithPassword`) with `{ "email", "password" }`. Add `organizationCode` if the user belongs to several organizations.
2. If the user has MFA enabled and no `mfaCode` was sent, the call returns `401` with `details[0] = { field: "mfaCode", issue: "mfa_required" }`. Repeat the login with `mfaCode` (TOTP or a recovery code).
3. The response contains `accessToken` (valid **15 minutes**), `refreshToken`, `expiresIn`, `organizationId` and `mfaSetupRequired`. When `mfaSetupRequired` is `true` the session may only call `beginMfaEnrolment` / `confirmMfaEnrolment` / `verifyMfaCode`.
4. Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every call. In Swagger UI press **Authorize** and paste the token (without the word "Bearer"); the page remembers it.
5. When the access token expires (`401 UNAUTHENTICATED`), call `POST /auth/refresh` with the refresh token. **Refresh tokens rotate**: use the new one from the response and discard the old one. The refresh token travels in the JSON body (there is no cookie, so no CSRF token is needed). Re-using an old refresh token revokes the session.
6. `POST /auth/logout` revokes the current session; `POST /auth/logout-all` revokes all of the user's sessions.

## 2. Tenancy (organizations)
Every business endpoint works inside the user's **active organization**, which comes from the access token.
**Never send `organizationId`** on tenant routes — it is ignored. To work in another organization call `POST /auth/switch-organization`
and use the returned token. `GET /me/organizations` lists the organizations the user belongs to.

## 3. Permissions, 403 and 404
`GET /me/permissions` (`getMyPermissions`) returns the permission keys of the caller; use them to show or hide UI actions. Each operation
below shows its required permission in the **Access** table and in `x-required-permission`.
* Missing permission → `403 FORBIDDEN`.
* A record of **another organization** (or a soft-deleted one) → `404 NOT_FOUND`, never `403`, so existence is not leaked.
* A module that is switched off for the organization → `404 NOT_FOUND` (see `x-feature-flag`).

## 4. Lists: pagination, filtering, sorting
Every response carries `errorMessage` (empty on success), `infoMessage` and `hasError`; the payload is in `data`. List responses add `"meta": { "limit", "nextCursor" }`.
* **Cursor pagination (default):** `?limit=25` (1-100) then pass `meta.nextCursor` as `?cursor=`. `nextCursor: null` means the last page. Cursors are opaque.
* **Offset pagination:** `?page=2&pageSize=25` adds `meta.total`.
* **Sorting:** `?sort=name` or `?sort=-created_at`; the allowed fields are listed per operation. Order is stable (tie-break on id).
* **Filtering:** `?filter[status]=active` (comma separates alternatives); allowed fields are listed per operation. `?q=` is a text search where supported.
* Unknown sort/filter fields return `422`.

## 5. Writing data
* **Idempotency:** send an `Idempotency-Key` (any unique string up to 128 chars) on operations that list it. Same key and same body within 24 h replays the original response with `Idempotent-Replay: true`; same key with a different body is `422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; while the first request is still running you get `409`. Some operations (sending invoices, recording payments, provisioning…) **require** the key.
* **Optimistic concurrency:** resources with a `rowVersion` return it on read. Send it back as `If-Match: "<rowVersion>"` or in the body when updating; a stale value returns `412 PRECONDITION_FAILED` — reload and retry.
* **Soft delete:** `DELETE` hides a record and a `restore` operation brings it back; permanent removal is a separate, protected `purge`.
* **Long-running work** (exports, imports, report exports) returns `202` and an id; poll the matching `get…ById` operation until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.

## 6. Conventions
* **Errors:** always `{ "errorMessage": [{ "id", "msg", "msgType": "Error", "code", "field?", "issue?" }], "infoMessage", "hasError": true, "requestId" }`. The first `errorMessage` entry is the summary (branch on its `code`, see **ErrorCode**, and show `msg`); validation errors add one entry per field (`field`, `issue`) to map onto form fields. Quote `requestId` (also the `X-Request-Id` header) to support.
* **Rate limits:** `429 RATE_LIMITED` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds). Sensitive endpoints (login, invitations, search) have stricter buckets.
* **Dates and times:** ISO-8601 in UTC (`2026-03-02T09:30:00.000Z`); calendar dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`.
* **Money:** decimal **strings** (`"1250.00"`) plus an ISO-4217 `currency`; never floats.
* **Identifiers:** UUIDs. Resource keys such as report keys or lookup types are lowercase strings.
* **Files:** upload with `multipart/form-data` (`uploadFile` / `uploadDocument`), then reference the returned `id`. Download with `getFileDownloadLink` (short-lived signed URL) or stream via `downloadFile`. Files are virus-scanned; infected files cannot be downloaded.
* **Versioning:** the version is in the path (`/api/v1`). Deprecated versions answer with `Deprecation: true` and a `Sunset` date header; `GET /meta/version` lists the versions served.
* **Maintenance mode:** `503 MAINTENANCE` with `Retry-After`; health and version endpoints stay available.
* **Webhooks:** outbound events and their signature scheme are in the **webhooks** section of this document.

## 7. Where to report problems
Send the `requestId` of the failing call, the operation id and the time to the platform support contact of your deployment
(see the `contact` field of this document).

servers.description: This server (same origin; used by "Try it out")

bearerAuth.description: Access token from `loginWithPassword` / `refreshAccessToken`. Lifetime is short; refresh with the refresh token (returned in the body, not a cookie).

apiKeyAuth.description: Machine API key created with `createApiKey`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer nxk_…`. Permissions are limited to the key's scopes.

portalAuth.description: Client-portal access token from `loginToPortal`. Separate realm: it is not accepted by staff endpoints.

msg.description: Human-readable text, safe to show to end users. Validation entries read `field: issue`.

code.description:
Machine-readable error code.
- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401): Missing, expired or revoked credentials. **UI:** Try POST /auth/refresh once; if that fails send the user to the sign-in screen.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): Authenticated but not allowed (missing permission, read-only support session, no active organization). **UI:** Hide the action using GET /me/permissions; show a "you do not have access" message.
- `TENANT_SUSPENDED` (403): The active organization is suspended. **UI:** Show a suspended-organization screen; only platform admins can reactivate.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): Resource does not exist, belongs to another organization, or its module is disabled. **UI:** Show a not-found state. Never retry.
- `CONFLICT` (409): Uniqueness or state conflict, or a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running. **UI:** Show the message; for in-flight idempotency retry after a short delay with the same key.
- `PRECONDITION_FAILED` (412): If-Match / rowVersion is missing or stale: someone else changed the record. **UI:** Reload the record, show a merge/overwrite prompt, resend with the new rowVersion.
- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (422): Body, query or path parameters failed validation; `details` lists each field. **UI:** Map `details[].field` to form fields and show `details[].issue` inline.
- `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` (422): The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request. **UI:** Generate a new key per distinct operation.
- `PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (402): The subscription plan does not include this feature or its quota is exhausted. **UI:** Show an upgrade prompt using GET /entitlements/{entitlementKey}.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429): Too many requests; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. **UI:** Back off for Retry-After seconds, then retry.
- `MAINTENANCE` (503): The service is in maintenance mode; `Retry-After` is set. **UI:** Show a maintenance banner and poll GET /health/ready.
- `INTERNAL` (500): Unexpected server error. `requestId` identifies it in the logs. **UI:** Show a generic error with the requestId so support can trace it.

errorMessage.description: Empty on success. On errors the first entry is the summary, followed by one entry per invalid field.

code.description:
Machine-readable error code.
- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401): Missing, expired or revoked credentials. **UI:** Try POST /auth/refresh once; if that fails send the user to the sign-in screen.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): Authenticated but not allowed (missing permission, read-only support session, no active organization). **UI:** Hide the action using GET /me/permissions; show a "you do not have access" message.
- `TENANT_SUSPENDED` (403): The active organization is suspended. **UI:** Show a suspended-organization screen; only platform admins can reactivate.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): Resource does not exist, belongs to another organization, or its module is disabled. **UI:** Show a not-found state. Never retry.
- `CONFLICT` (409): Uniqueness or state conflict, or a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running. **UI:** Show the message; for in-flight idempotency retry after a short delay with the same key.
- `PRECONDITION_FAILED` (412): If-Match / rowVersion is missing or stale: someone else changed the record. **UI:** Reload the record, show a merge/overwrite prompt, resend with the new rowVersion.
- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (422): Body, query or path parameters failed validation; `details` lists each field. **UI:** Map `details[].field` to form fields and show `details[].issue` inline.
- `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` (422): The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request. **UI:** Generate a new key per distinct operation.
- `PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (402): The subscription plan does not include this feature or its quota is exhausted. **UI:** Show an upgrade prompt using GET /entitlements/{entitlementKey}.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429): Too many requests; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. **UI:** Back off for Retry-After seconds, then retry.
- `MAINTENANCE` (503): The service is in maintenance mode; `Retry-After` is set. **UI:** Show a maintenance banner and poll GET /health/ready.
- `INTERNAL` (500): Unexpected server error. `requestId` identifies it in the logs. **UI:** Show a generic error with the requestId so support can trace it.

code.description:
Machine-readable error code.
- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401): Missing, expired or revoked credentials. **UI:** Try POST /auth/refresh once; if that fails send the user to the sign-in screen.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): Authenticated but not allowed (missing permission, read-only support session, no active organization). **UI:** Hide the action using GET /me/permissions; show a "you do not have access" message.
- `TENANT_SUSPENDED` (403): The active organization is suspended. **UI:** Show a suspended-organization screen; only platform admins can reactivate.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): Resource does not exist, belongs to another organization, or its module is disabled. **UI:** Show a not-found state. Never retry.
- `CONFLICT` (409): Uniqueness or state conflict, or a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running. **UI:** Show the message; for in-flight idempotency retry after a short delay with the same key.
- `PRECONDITION_FAILED` (412): If-Match / rowVersion is missing or stale: someone else changed the record. **UI:** Reload the record, show a merge/overwrite prompt, resend with the new rowVersion.
- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (422): Body, query or path parameters failed validation; `details` lists each field. **UI:** Map `details[].field` to form fields and show `details[].issue` inline.
- `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` (422): The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request. **UI:** Generate a new key per distinct operation.
- `PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (402): The subscription plan does not include this feature or its quota is exhausted. **UI:** Show an upgrade prompt using GET /entitlements/{entitlementKey}.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429): Too many requests; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. **UI:** Back off for Retry-After seconds, then retry.
- `MAINTENANCE` (503): The service is in maintenance mode; `Retry-After` is set. **UI:** Show a maintenance banner and poll GET /health/ready.
- `INTERNAL` (500): Unexpected server error. `requestId` identifies it in the logs. **UI:** Show a generic error with the requestId so support can trace it.

code.description:
Machine-readable error code.
- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401): Missing, expired or revoked credentials. **UI:** Try POST /auth/refresh once; if that fails send the user to the sign-in screen.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): Authenticated but not allowed (missing permission, read-only support session, no active organization). **UI:** Hide the action using GET /me/permissions; show a "you do not have access" message.
- `TENANT_SUSPENDED` (403): The active organization is suspended. **UI:** Show a suspended-organization screen; only platform admins can reactivate.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): Resource does not exist, belongs to another organization, or its module is disabled. **UI:** Show a not-found state. Never retry.
- `CONFLICT` (409): Uniqueness or state conflict, or a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running. **UI:** Show the message; for in-flight idempotency retry after a short delay with the same key.
- `PRECONDITION_FAILED` (412): If-Match / rowVersion is missing or stale: someone else changed the record. **UI:** Reload the record, show a merge/overwrite prompt, resend with the new rowVersion.
- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (422): Body, query or path parameters failed validation; `details` lists each field. **UI:** Map `details[].field` to form fields and show `details[].issue` inline.
- `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` (422): The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request. **UI:** Generate a new key per distinct operation.
- `PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (402): The subscription plan does not include this feature or its quota is exhausted. **UI:** Show an upgrade prompt using GET /entitlements/{entitlementKey}.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429): Too many requests; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. **UI:** Back off for Retry-After seconds, then retry.
- `MAINTENANCE` (503): The service is in maintenance mode; `Retry-After` is set. **UI:** Show a maintenance banner and poll GET /health/ready.
- `INTERNAL` (500): Unexpected server error. `requestId` identifies it in the logs. **UI:** Show a generic error with the requestId so support can trace it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated unique key (max 128 chars). Replaying the same key with the same body within 24 h returns the stored response (`Idempotent-Replay: true`); a different body returns `422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; while the first request is still running, `409`.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Client-generated unique key (max 128 chars) — **required** for this operation. Same key + same body replays the stored response for 24 h; a different body returns `422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The `rowVersion` you last read, optionally quoted. A stale or missing value returns `412 PRECONDITION_FAILED`. `rowVersion` in the body is accepted as an alternative.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description:
Accepts plain credentials or the encrypted `AuthenticateUser` shape: call `getLoginToken` first, then send `userLoginId` (email) and `password` AES-256-CBC encrypted (base64, PKCS7) with `tokenkeys` = the `[key, iv]` array. A forged/expired `tokenkeys` or undecryptable field returns `422` (`invalid_or_expired`). `clientCode` is used as `organizationCode` when that is absent. Signs in and returns the token bundle. Failed attempts increase a lockout (see the security policy). `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` is returned for wrong credentials, unverified or locked accounts and when MFA is required but `mfaCode` is missing (`details[0] = { field: "mfaCode", issue: "mfa_required" }`). A user in several organizations passes `organizationCode`; otherwise the last/only one is used.

- `activity.trend` → array of `{ bucket: ISO date, count: number }` (bucketed by `granularity`)
- `access.pending_requests` → `{ pending: number }`
- `storage.usage` → `{ usedBytes: number, quotaBytes: number }`

msg.description: Human-readable text, safe to show to end users. Validation entries read `field: issue`.

code.description:
Machine-readable error code.
- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401): Missing, expired or revoked credentials. **UI:** Try POST /auth/refresh once; if that fails send the user to the sign-in screen.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): Authenticated but not allowed (missing permission, read-only support session, no active organization). **UI:** Hide the action using GET /me/permissions; show a "you do not have access" message.
- `TENANT_SUSPENDED` (403): The active organization is suspended. **UI:** Show a suspended-organization screen; only platform admins can reactivate.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): Resource does not exist, belongs to another organization, or its module is disabled. **UI:** Show a not-found state. Never retry.
- `CONFLICT` (409): Uniqueness or state conflict, or a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running. **UI:** Show the message; for in-flight idempotency retry after a short delay with the same key.
- `PRECONDITION_FAILED` (412): If-Match / rowVersion is missing or stale: someone else changed the record. **UI:** Reload the record, show a merge/overwrite prompt, resend with the new rowVersion.
- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (422): Body, query or path parameters failed validation; `details` lists each field. **UI:** Map `details[].field` to form fields and show `details[].issue` inline.
- `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` (422): The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request. **UI:** Generate a new key per distinct operation.
- `PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (402): The subscription plan does not include this feature or its quota is exhausted. **UI:** Show an upgrade prompt using GET /entitlements/{entitlementKey}.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429): Too many requests; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. **UI:** Back off for Retry-After seconds, then retry.
- `MAINTENANCE` (503): The service is in maintenance mode; `Retry-After` is set. **UI:** Show a maintenance banner and poll GET /health/ready.
- `INTERNAL` (500): Unexpected server error. `requestId` identifies it in the logs. **UI:** Show a generic error with the requestId so support can trace it.

field.description: Dotted path of the offending input, e.g. `body.name`. Validation entries only.

issue.description: What is wrong with that input. Validation entries only.

post.summary: An invoice was issued to the customer
post.description:
Delivered to every active endpoint subscribed to `invoice.sent` (or `*`). Respond with any **2xx within 10 seconds**.

**Headers**
- `X-Nexus-Signature`: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the endpoint secret>`. During secret rotation two space-separated signatures are sent; accept either. Reject timestamps older than 5 minutes.
- `X-Nexus-Event`: event type · `X-Nexus-Delivery`: delivery id · `User-Agent: Zellavora-Nexus-Webhooks/1`.

**Retries**: up to 6 attempts with back-off of 30 s, 2 min, 10 min, 1 h, 6 h; then the delivery is `dead`. After 20 consecutive failures the endpoint is auto-disabled. Redirects are not followed; non-HTTPS URLs are rejected in production.

**Replay**: `replayWebhookEvent` re-sends a stored event to the current endpoints, and `retryWebhookDelivery` retries a failed/dead delivery. The event `id` stays the same.

id.description: Event id; identical across retries and replays, use it for de-duplication.

createdAt.description: When the event occurred (ISO-8601 UTC).

data.description: Event-specific payload (shape shown in the example).
